connector.name: Nuzo Memory
connector.registryDescription: Local-first, auditable memory for MCP-compatible AI agents with explicit writes and SQLite storage.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package memory-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the fabionfsc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: NUZO_MEMORY_STORE
env.description: Optional absolute path to the local SQLite memory store.

env.name: NUZO_MEMORY_SCOPE
env.description: Optional default Nuzo memory scope, such as user:default or project:auto.

env.name: NUZO_AUTHORIZED_SCOPES
env.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of memory scopes available to this MCP process.

env.name: NUZO_PROJECT_ROOT
env.description: Optional project root used to resolve project:auto scope.
